---
title: "Task Definition"
---

## Problem statement

- **Domain**: inference acceleration of the multimodal diffusion LLM LLaDA-V (released checkpoint, no training).
- **Input**: an image plus a question; prompt length N = 1.0k–3.7k tokens, mostly visual (Exp 1).
- **Output**: an answer of fixed length (gen_length), decoded over a fixed number of denoising steps.
- **Lever**: when to recompute the full key–value cache (a "refresh"); every other setting stays fixed.
- **Why it is hard**: skipping refreshes saves time, but one stale step can redirect the whole answer (Obs 1).

```{dot}
//| label: fig-problem
//| fig-cap: "Only the refresh schedule changes; cost and quality are measured on the same runs"
//| fig-width: 7
//| fig-height: 2.8
digraph G {
  bgcolor="transparent"
  rankdir=TB
  graph [ranksep=0.5, nodesep=0.5]

  P [label="Refresh schedule"]
  {rank=same; T [label="Wall-clock"]; Q [label="Quality"]}
  I -> P
  M -> P
  P -> T
  P -> Q
}
```

---

## Objective

- Reach the quality of fixed-interval refresh (Fast-dLLM) with a lower full-refresh ratio r.
- r = refresh steps / all denoising steps; fixed interval k gives r ≈ 1/k (Exp 3: 0.502 at k = 2).
- Success = lower end-to-end wall-clock at matched quality, not fewer theoretical FLOPs.
- Opponents: the fixed-interval frontier k ∈ {1, …, 32} and Elastic-Cache.
- Win bar (G4, frozen): ≥ 25% lower wall-clock on ≥ 2 of the anchors k = 2 / 4 / 8, Holm-significant.

```{dot}

//| fig-cap: "Push the frontier right at fixed quality"
//| fig-width: 7

  A -> R -> W
}
```

---

## Tasks and metrics

| Task | Role | Length | Quality metric |
|---|---|---|---|
| Detailed captioning (50 MME images) | Reproduction ground; agreement study | 128 | Word-set Jaccard vs full (BERTScore planned) |
| MathVerse (thinking mode) | Main ground; accuracy anchors | to be fixed (plan: 256–512) | Task accuracy (primary) |
| Short-answer VQA | Boundary evidence only | short | Accuracy |

- Cost: generation seconds per sample on one GPU type; speedup over full; measured r.
- Probe or signal cost is converted into an equivalent r increment.
- Replacement error (KL, top-1 flip) is a diagnostic only, never a reported quality number.

---

## Scope

- In scope: refresh timing, and which position groups / layers get refreshed.
- Out of scope: training, distillation, changing gen_length / steps / threshold within a comparison.
- Baselines deferred until G2 / G3 (user decision 2026-10-29): Elastic-Cache and dKV-Cache ports to LLaDA-V.
